read.thesis: Homebuilder cutting starts 45% QoQ and guiding FY27 closings flat to down, but Q1 home-sales gross margin falls to 18-18.5% as incentives stay elevated; supply discipline is real but pricing is not yet clearing.

capex.quote: We started 13.1 thousand homes in the September quarter. Down 45% sequentially and 10% from the prior year quarter to align with the current sales environment.

triggers.label: Starts down 45% QoQ to 13.1K
triggers.quote: We started 13.1 thousand homes in the September quarter. Down 45% sequentially and 10% from the prior year quarter

triggers.label: Q1 GM guide 18%-18.5%
triggers.quote: We expect our home sales gross margin for the first quarter to be in the range of 18% to 18.5%

triggers.label: Net orders down 7%, cancellations 23%
triggers.quote: Net sales orders in the fourth quarter decreased 7% from the prior year quarter to 18.6 thousand homes.
triggers.highlight: decreased 7% from the prior year quarter

triggers.label: FY27 revenue $30-32B, closings 79-84K
triggers.quote: we currently expect to generate consolidated revenues of approximately 30 to $32 billion

guidance.quote: we currently expect to generate consolidated revenues of approximately 30 to $32 billion
homes closed by our homebuilding operations to be in the range of 79 thousand to 84 thousand homes
We expect to generate approximately $3.5 billion of cash flow from operations in fiscal 2027
we currently plan to repurchase approximately $3 billion of our common stock

guidance.metric: Q1 FY27 home sales gross margin
guidance.quote: We expect our home sales gross margin for the first quarter to be in the range of 18% to 18.5%
homes closed for our homebuilding operations to be in the range of 15.5 thousand to 16.5 thousand homes
our consolidated pre tax profit margin to be in the range of 7% to 8%

red_flags.label: Cancellations rising to 23%
red_flags.quote: Our cancellation rate for the quarter was 23%, compared to 20% sequentially and year over year.

red_flags.label: Q4 litigation costs above normal
red_flags.quote: We had to increase our reserves for 2 cases that we now believe are gonna come in at higher settlements

evasions.quote: I think that anticipating it to go down is not prudent at all.
